احدودقت (form XII)

# اِحْدَوْدَقْتَ (iḥdawdaqta) /iħ.daw.daq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
# اِحْدَوْدَقْتِ (iḥdawdaqti) /iħ.daw.daq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْدَوْدَقَ (iḥdawdaqa)
# اِحْدَوْدَقَتْ (iḥdawdaqat) /iħ
